trust_decision.summary: Whether the repository's configured SOCKS5 proxy URL (hostname/port from url.Parse) may be interpolated into the shell-interpreted GIT_SSH_COMMAND ProxyCommand string; decided (not at all) in SSHCreds.Environ in util/git/creds.go.

landing_point.why: The only place a ProxyCommand/connect-proxy string is built; 'SSH SOCKS5 proxy' in the summary leads straight to it via grep.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any repo-server git operation on an SSH repo with a proxy (fetch/ls-remote via nativeGitClient.runCredentialedCmd util/git/client.go:1835); repo add/update via API/CLI 'argocd repo add --proxy' or a declarative repository Secret

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP creds constructor (hardening; proxy flows to net/http, not a shell)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All fix sites are in util/git/creds.go; GitHubApp/Azure proxy validation (util/git/creds.go:417, util/git/creds.go:1041) is defence-in-depth for proxies that never reach a shell, so a hidden test on them would be about HTTP creds rather than a real second implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The GitHub App / Azure Service Principal proxy values only feed Go http.Transport (util/git/client.go:346-384), not a shell, so a solver can correctly argue they are not command-injection sinks.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: SOCKS5 credentials in the proxy URL userinfo (SOCKS5_USER / SOCKS5_PASSWD env vars), plus socks5h scheme and bracketed IPv6 hosts, must keep working; validating the whole raw URL string for metacharacters would reject passwords with '$' or '&'.

O6_input_shapes: wrong scheme (http, https, socks4) for SSH

O7_producer.where: util/db/repository_secrets.go:447 (repository Secret 'proxy' key) and repo-creds inheritance pkg/apis/application/v1alpha1/repository_types.go:258-260

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second user-controlled ssh option (e.g. a per-repo ssh port, extra ssh option, or known-hosts path) interpolated into the same GIT_SSH_COMMAND string.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GIT_SSH_COMMAND is assembled by strings.Join of args and is shell-parsed by git; a maintainer adding a repo field would naturally append another '-o' option the same way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A kustomize/helm-specific SSH env builder (copy of the ProxyCommand construction) for remote bases.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Kustomize already consumes creds.Environ for remote bases; a separate builder in another package would be a credible second implementation at distance.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: CMP sidecar path that re-derives GIT_SSH_COMMAND from repo.Proxy itself when ProvideGitCreds is set.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CMP path forwards git creds env to the plugin; a variant that builds its own proxy command for the sidecar's tooling is plausible.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78) via shell-interpreted environment variable (GIT_SSH_COMMAND)

O10_build.project_tests: util/git/creds_test.go (Test_SSHCreds_Environ_WithProxy, Test_SSHCreds_Environ_WithProxyUserNamePassword, Test_SSHCreds_Environ_TempFileCleanupOnInvalidProxyURL); unit tests inspect env strings without running ssh

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Shell-quote or strip single quotes from the hostname in the ProxyCommand fmt.Sprintf (blacklist), rather than allow-list validating host/port/scheme.

out_of_scope_notes: knownHostsFile from certutil.GetSSHKnownHostsDataPath() is also joined unquoted into GIT_SSH_COMMAND (util/git/creds.go:373-374) but is operator-controlled env, not repo-controlled.

Hidden tests require NewSSHCreds to blank the unexported proxy field and Environ to return NoError for a rejected proxy (fix.diff:324-337, fix.diff:404-411); a solver that returns an error from Environ instead would fail on behaviour the report may not specify.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no du run); argo-cd source is likely 50-200 MB, so tiny_repo/giant_repo not flagged.
Did not exhaustively check helm/oci clients for any shell construction from repo.Proxy; grep for ProxyCommand/connect-proxy/GIT_SSH_COMMAND found only util/git/creds.go:384 and :394 in Go sources.
